cards.body:
## Summary
Give every camp intent one rule row (legality extras, effect, preview, option enumeration, label, presence need, cap) and make resolve, actionPreview, campActions, playerProblem and reconcile dispatch through it.

## Description
The camp simulator's knowledge of what an intent does lives in five places: the 273-line resolve switch (camp.ts:520-792), a hand-copied preview (camp-session.ts:537-584), a hand-enumerated option ladder (camp-session.ts:389-416), a hand-listed presence rule (camp-session.ts:177) and a cap rule written three times. Adding an intent, or changing a formula, means editing all of them in step, and the preview already re-derives BEFRIEND/TRAIN math by hand - the next tuning change can make the screen lie with no test noticing. A rulebook module collapses this to one row per intent, with a property test that the preview a row shows is the delta its effect writes.

## Flow
- Capture campActions output on 6 planted sessions as a fixture at 2d83a1e.
- Add camp-rules.ts: capFor(), boardLine(), and a Record<Intent, IntentRule> with effect(ctx), preview(t,s,d), options(t,s), needsPresence, label.
- resolve keeps its ordering, set/add/trace helpers and night settlement; the switch body becomes campRules[item.intent].effect(ctx). Trace rule strings stay byte-identical.
- actionPreview, campActions and playerProblem read the row; the three cap sites call capFor.

## Expected impact
One place to change an intent; previews that cannot drift from resolution; camp.ts drops from 970 lines to roughly 450 and the switch disappears. Unblocks Slot B (odds) and any future intent.

## Evaluation
Claim: the rulebook is a pure refactor that removes five parallel encodings.
Before: 0 of 7 acceptance cases pass (camp-rules.ts absent; cases 6 is already green and must stay so)
After: 7 of 7
Method: gate - npm run gate; golden-nights oracle (director.test.ts) and golden-mornings (camp-evidence.test.ts) unchanged; campActions fixture byte-equal
Result: better
Gate: architecture

cards.title: Contest odds on every camp action and parley card, from the resolver's own DC
shared_surfaces: packages/core/src/camp.ts resolve() contest branches (WATCH :595-598, REPORT :615-617, SCHEME :643-658 and caught :720-721, RECRUIT :748-752) - also Slot A's write set
packages/core/src/camp-session.ts actionPreview (:569-576) - also Slot A's write set
acceptance: case 1: contestOdds({bonus:0, dc:10, sides:20}) -> 0.5; {bonus:25, dc:10, sides:20} -> 1; {bonus:0, dc:20, sides:20} -> 0 (success iff bonus + die > dc, die uniform 1..sides)

case 2: campView(t, s).actions for WATCH on every present target -> each row carries odds.success equal to contestOdds of the resolver's own bonus/dc (guile*guileMultiplier vs baseDc + target guile*guileMultiplier), and over seeds 1..400 the share of actCamp WATCH runs with no noticedTrust trace is within 0.06 of it

case 3: a SCHEME row -> carries odds.success and odds.caught = (1 - success) * P(vigilBonus + die > guile*guileMultiplier + baseDc), honouring rumourFailsAtOrBelow for rumour; over seeds 1..400 the share of actCamp SCHEME runs that set characters/<player>/stocks is within 0.06 of odds.caught
case 4: toggling the target's hidden `warned` flag in the planted state -> previewed odds unchanged (no hidden-state leak); the preview text names that a warned target is harder

case 5: parleyCards(s, target) -> a card whose effect is large carries odds from its stance (intimidate reads nerve, the rest guile, vs parley contestDc); shift_trust_small and refuse cards carry odds null; over seeds 1..400 applyParley's roll.success share matches within 0.06
case 6: actionSubtitle({hours:2, gains:'discover a fact', odds:{success:0.55, caught:null}}) -> '2 hours · 55% · discover a fact'; odds null -> today's '2 hours · <gains>' string unchanged

case 7: goldenNights(t) canonical -> equals docs/design/reconciled/fixtures/golden-nights.json unchanged, and packages/tools/src/camp-evidence.test.ts stays green (resolve calls the shared helper but its rolls, outcomes and Roll records are byte-identical)

packages/core/src/camp.ts:595-598, :615-617, :656-660, :720-721, :748-752 - five contest formulas, each 'stat*guileMultiplier + die > dc', written inline
packages/core/src/parley.ts:210-213 - parley's contest is the same shape against parley contestDc 15 (docs/design/reconciled/data/parley.json:8), and parleyCards (parley.ts:104-114) returns no chance
packages/core/src/season.ts:390 - the Trial rolls the same die again; a shared contest primitive serves all three
docs/design/reconciled/data/rules.json:130-133 - d20, guileMultiplier 4, baseDc 10, vigilBonus 8: one guile rank moves odds by 20 points, so the number is decision-relevant, not decoration

cards.body:
## Summary
Show the player the real chance of every contest before they spend hours on it: camp WATCH/SCHEME/RECRUIT/REPORT rows and parley cards carry a success percentage (and, for SCHEME, the stocks risk) computed by the same helper the resolver rolls against.

## Description
Camp time is the scarce resource (a day has fixed waking hours; a contest act costs two). Today the screen labels a 20%-chance scheme and an 80%-chance watch identically, 'Guile contest', although the resolver already knows both sides' guile, the DC and the die. The code has the data; the decision is blind. A pure contest.ts holds 'bonus + d(sides) > dc' once; resolve and applyParley call it for their rolls (byte-identical outcomes), and the previews call its closed-form odds. Hidden state (a PROTECT warning, a REPORT stop) is excluded from the preview by design so odds never leak secrets.

## Flow
- contest.ts: contestOdds({bonus, dc, sides}) and per-contest bonus/dc builders used by resolve, applyParley and the preview.
- campView actions gain odds: {success, caught|null}; parleyCards gain odds for large-effect cards.
- screens/camp.ts subtitle and screens/parley.ts card text render the percentage via a pure actionSubtitle().

## Expected impact
Every contest choice in the camp becomes an informed bet; the parley stance choice (nerve vs guile) becomes legible. One contest formula instead of seven inline copies.

## Evaluation
Claim: previewed odds equal the resolver's empirical success rate and the screen shows them.
Before: 0 of 7 acceptance cases pass (no contest module, no odds field; case 7 green and must stay so)
After: 7 of 7
Method: gate - npm run gate; 400-seed agreement tests against actCamp/applyParley; golden-nights + golden-mornings unchanged
Result: better
Gate: direction (shows target-derived odds the player did not see before; hidden-state exclusion is the design rule)
